outcomeActions.label: Pay
outcomeActions.outcomeLine: Send money to a recipient through your connected providers.
advancedDisclosure: Route candidates with legs, fees and rails before any submission
Quote terms with fees, rate provenance, expiry and estimate-vs-guarantee labels
Security gates and UNKNOWN/risk disclosures per candidate
Before/after balances as typed observations
Evidence for every definitive outcome

outcomeActions.label: Receive
outcomeActions.outcomeLine: Request money from a payer — a collect request they can fulfill.
advancedDisclosure: The collect request contract and its payer-visible summary
Fulfillment attempts with UNKNOWN rendered as reconciliation
Evidence lineage for the received payment

outcomeActions.label: Move
outcomeActions.outcomeLine: Move money to another account you control through the payout journey to a registered settlement destination.
advancedDisclosure: Settlement destination selection (registered destinations only)
The payout gate report and its authorization lineage
Custody chain of the movement, leg by leg
A payout sent is not beneficiary credit — stated on the surface

outcomeActions.label: Convert
outcomeActions.outcomeLine: Convert between currencies and assets — the quoted terms, their fees and honest exclusions, before anything moves.
advancedDisclosure: Every fee line item disclosed verbatim — never a hidden fee
Rate value, provenance and as-of time
Expiry and material-change revalidation rules
Delivery estimate labeled estimate or guarantee — never conflated
Ineligible candidates with their typed reasons — never silently dropped

outcomeActions.label: Checkout
outcomeActions.outcomeLine: The merchant checkout journey: fiat-first pricing with the explicit crypto acceptance layer and customer explicit-signing.
advancedDisclosure: Merchant onboarding state (DRAFT → SUBMITTED → VERIFIED → ACTIVE)
Crypto acceptance policy activation and quote observations with expiry
The customer payment summary and the typed authorization diff
Settlement route selection: native provider acceptance vs external PaySwap conversion

areas.label: Overview
areas.purpose: The home view: what needs attention, recent activity, quick outcomes.

emptyState.reason: No session-scoped observations yet — the overview renders only what the authoritative planes provide.

areas.label: Payments
areas.purpose: Money in and money out: pay, receive, move — plus the payment object spine.

emptyState.reason: No connected payment capability yet — journeys start from connected instances only.

areas.label: Accounts
areas.purpose: Balances and positions across providers — every number an OBSERVATION of an external provider, never PaySwap custody.

emptyState.reason: No provider balance observations exist — external provider balances are observations, and none have been observed in this deployment.

areas.label: Activity
areas.purpose: The chronological ledger of actions with their honest states and evidence links.

emptyState.reason: No recorded activity yet — activity rows come from authoritative records, never from the UI.

areas.label: Opportunities
areas.purpose: Discovered opportunities with honest risk and eligibility — never guaranteed returns.

emptyState.reason: No opportunity observations yet — discovery runs on real capability observations only.

areas.label: Connections
areas.purpose: The connected-instance model: a provider catalogue capability is never a connection — execution is scoped to actual account authorization.

emptyState.reason: No connected instances yet — the catalogue is browsable, but nothing is authorized until you connect.

areas.label: Capabilities
areas.purpose: The honest capability and coverage explorer over recorded provider-probe evidence.

emptyState.reason: Capability coverage renders from recorded probe evidence — the explorer carries the same honesty.

areas.label: Security
areas.purpose: Human-readable warnings and blocks — the BLOCK/ALLOW/UNKNOWN gate vocabulary in people language with typed drill-down.

emptyState.reason: No gate records yet — security findings appear here as they occur in real journeys.

areas.label: Reports
areas.purpose: Reporting over evidence-backed records — every figure traceable to its evidence.

emptyState.reason: No reportable records yet — reports generate from the same evidence the activity ledger records.

areas.label: Developers
areas.purpose: The developer surface: API surface, webhooks, keys — test/live visibly distinct.

emptyState.reason: The developer surface renders the same contracts the programmatic clients consume.

areas.label: Settings
areas.purpose: Account, role and session preferences — mode switches visible and honest.

emptyState.reason: Settings render from the session's own authority — nothing is configurable without one.
